evidence_text: Won five golds and one silver at the 2016 Rio Olympics.

event_description: Final retirement after Rio
evidence_text: Second retirement announced August 12, 2016.

event_description: First senior Grand Prix Final title (St. Petersburg)
evidence_text: Won the 2006–07 Grand Prix Final in St. Petersburg in her senior debut season.

event_description: Lumbar disc herniation; withdrew from national championships
evidence_text: Diagnosed January 2007 with early lumbar disc herniation; withdrew from nationals.

event_description: Chronic hip pain; missed Four Continents
evidence_text: Chronic hip pain kept her out of the 2008 Four Continents Championships.

event_description: World Champion (Los Angeles), first woman over 200 points
evidence_text: Won 2009 Worlds in Los Angeles with record total 207.71.

event_description: Vancouver Olympic gold with world-record 228.56
evidence_text: Won Vancouver gold with world-record total of 228.56 points.

event_description: World Championships silver (Moscow) behind Miki Ando
evidence_text: Took silver at 2011 Worlds in Moscow with 194.50 points.

event_description: Announced sitting out 2011-12 season
evidence_text: Announced October 18, 2011 she would sit out the 2011–12 season.

event_description: Announced return aiming at Sochi 2014
evidence_text: Announced intent to return to competition in July 2012.

event_description: Second World title (London, Ontario)
evidence_text: Won the 2013 World Championships in London.

event_description: Sochi Olympic silver behind Sotnikova; Korean protest rejected
evidence_text: Upset by Russia's Adelina Sotnikova, finishing with silver at Sochi.

event_description: Retired from competition after Sochi (age 23)
evidence_text: Confirmed at age 23 she will retire after the Sochi Games.

event_description: Married singer Ko Woo-rim in Seoul
evidence_text: Private wedding with singer Ko Woo-rim in Seoul, October 22, 2022.

event_description: Pro debut with Kyoto Purple Sanga (J-League)
evidence_text: Signed with Kyoto Purple Sanga May 2000; debut 24 June 2000.

event_description: Winning goal vs Portugal at 2002 World Cup; Korea reached semifinal
evidence_text: Scored in the 70th minute against Portugal at the 2002 World Cup.

event_description: Moved to PSV Eindhoven
evidence_text: Arrived in Eindhoven 7 February 2003; Eredivisie debut next day.

event_description: Transfer to Manchester United (~£4M)
evidence_text: PSV agreed reported £4 million fee; transfer completed July 2005.

event_description: Right knee cartilage surgery; out about eight-nine months
evidence_text: Knee surgery in 2007 kept him out for eight months.

event_description: Premier League title; United won Champions League but he was left out of final squad
evidence_text: Won 2007–08 Premier League; left out of the Champions League final squad.

event_description: Lost Champions League final to Barcelona (first Asian to play in a final)
evidence_text: Lost the Champions League final 2–0 to Barcelona on 27 May 2009.

event_description: Retired from international football
evidence_text: Announced international retirement 31 January 2011, after the Asian Cup.

event_description: Fourth Premier League title (2010-11)
evidence_text: Won four Premier League titles, including 2010–11.

event_description: Lost Champions League final to Barcelona at Wembley
evidence_text: Lost 3–1 to Barcelona at Wembley on 28 May 2011.

event_description: Joined Queens Park Rangers
evidence_text: Joined QPR 9 July 2012 on a two-year contract.

event_description: Loan back to PSV Eindhoven
evidence_text: Returned to PSV on season-long loan 8 August 2013.

evidence_text: Said his knee won't hold up another season; retired at 33.

evidence_text: Planned to marry former SBS announcer Kim Min-ji on July 27 in Seoul.
